# bindings/ — GENERATED. DO NOT EDIT.

TypeScript types generated from `crates/protocol/` by `ts-rs`.

```
cargo test -p p2pgpu-protocol
```

**If you are editing a file in this directory, you have made a mistake** (rule R3). Change the Rust type in `crates/protocol/` and regenerate.

These files are committed so `web/` builds without a Rust toolchain. CI verifies they are current by regenerating and diffing (`docs/CONVENTIONS.md` §8) — a stale binding is a build failure, not a warning.

Wire format spec: `docs/PROTOCOL.md`.
